post.description: Requires an active login session (cookie), not another API key — you can't mint a key using a key. The "key" field is shown only once and cannot be retrieved again.
Public endpoint. Validates email/password and sets access_token/refresh_token cookies.
Public endpoint (relies on the refresh_token cookie, not JWT auth). Atomically claims and rotates the refresh token.
Public endpoint. Registration closes after 2 accounts exist; role is server-assigned (first=admin, second=guest).

description.description: Spanish how-to text; empty until seeded or written in the app.

durationSeconds.description:
Both stay 0 on a weight_reps set. They live here rather than in a
separate cardio table so progress queries stay one path, and so hybrids
(Farmers Walk, Sled Push) can carry weight and distance at once.

estimated1rmGrams.description: Epley estimate from the top set: weight x (1 + reps/30).

totalDurationSeconds.description:
Cardio and hold metrics. Volume and 1RM are meaningless for those, so
the client charts these instead depending on the exercise's tracking
type — see ProgressMetric on the frontend.

topMuscle.description: Empty when nothing has been logged in the trailing 90 days.

weekStreak.description:
Consecutive weeks with at least one session — weeks, not days, because
rest days are part of training.

trackingType.description:
Empty defaults to weight_reps, so an older client that doesn't know
about tracking types still creates a usable exercise.

occurredOn.description: Date of the session the sets came from. Empty when there are none.

routineId.description: Optional: when set, the session is materialized from that template.

BearerAuth.description: Static token used by CLI and public share routes, sent as "Bearer <token>".
BearerAuth.name: Authorization

CookieAuth.description: JWT access token issued by /api/auth/login, sent as the access_token cookie (not an Authorization header — see middleware.JWTAuth).
CookieAuth.name: access_token
